thread.title: Technology Sector Update for 11/13/2018: EVER, GDS, MGIC, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG

author: MT Newswires
title: Technology Sector Update for 11/13/2018: EVER, GDS, MGIC, MSFT, AAPL, IBM, CSCO, GOOG
text:
Technology stocks were mostly advancing pre-market Tuesday.
Early movers include:
(-) EverQuote ( EVER ), which was declining by more than 16% after it reported a wider loss but higher revenue in its most recent quarter. Net loss expanded to $0.15 per share in the September quarter, from a net loss of $0.07 per share in the year-earlier period.
(+) GDS Holdings ( GDS ) reported a Q3 net loss of RMB0.96 ($0.14) per American depositary share, compared with a net loss of RMB0.95 per ADS in the prior-year period. The company's ADS were up more than 7%.
In other sector news:
(=) Magic Software Enterprises ( MGIC ) shares were unchanged as the company reported Q3 adjusted earnings of $0.14 per share, up from $0.12 in the same period a year ago. Three analysts polled by Capital IQ expected adjusted EPS of $0.15.
